text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"automated_researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFeCo_OER_screen_continuation","campaign_class":"benign_oer_parameter_sweep","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate; plate previously initialized in prior session (see campaign log)"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"routine CP baseline on pre-initialized plate","label":"post_init_measurement"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,25,0,35,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,0]},"comment":"adjacent composition point, same session"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"incorporate new OER overpotential data"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"housekeeping re-sync of plate state (no-op if already initialized)"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,0],"thickness":100},"comment":"standard thin film for follow-up"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":400,"duration":60,"substrate":"FTO"},"comment":"standard anneal within substrate limits"}]}
